title: A trigger's definition
description: A trigger, with a prompt or a prompt_file. agent.trigger_set and agent.trigger_remove return it with its name. A scheduled trigger has every. Add timezone for cron expressions outside UTC. A feed trigger has feed, with one or more RSS or Atom feeds. A webhook trigger has webhook instead of every. Set its secret as ${NAME} and verify to shared or standard. It receives requests at POST /v1/hooks/{agent}/{trigger}. The defaults are overlap settle (queue for webhooks), missed run_once and jitter 0.

name.description: The trigger name, taken from the path.

every.description: A cron expression, or an interval such as 30m.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone for a cron expression in every, such as Europe/Berlin. Defaults to Etc/UTC. Not used with an interval.

prompt.description: The prompt sent to the agent on each run.

prompt_file.description: Use instead of prompt. A file in the agent's workspace. Each run asks the agent to read the file and follow its instructions. The agent's tools must include files.

overlap.description: What happens if the agent is busy when the trigger fires. skip skips the run. queue runs it after the current turn. settle cancels a turn that is waiting for an approval and runs. If the turn isn't waiting for an approval, settle skips the run.

missed.description: What to do about runs missed while the server was down.

jitter.description: A random delay of up to this many seconds before each run.

feed.description: An RSS or Atom feed URL, or a list of them. The agent runs only when a feed has new entries, which are added below the prompt. The first check records the current entries without running the agent.

secret.description: The shared secret, as a reference, for example ${NAME}.

verify.description: How requests are verified. With shared, the request sends the secret as a bearer token or as the last path segment of the URL. With standard, the request is signed as the Standard Webhooks spec describes. Defaults to shared.

webhook.description: Use instead of every. An external service sends requests to the trigger. Each request runs the agent once.
